transcript: How much money can I make dropshipping viral products on Instagram? Let's find out on episode 2 of Unbroking India. Even kids today are becoming millionaires by doing this same thing. Mujhe khudpe sharam aati hai. So, step 1, let's find these products. I scrolled Instagram Reels for 2 hours and found these 10 products that were going viral. Then I went on these 3 websites and found their suppliers. Step 2, building the store. I went on Emergent and gave it details of all our products. It built me a high converting online store for every single item. It also added order verification to reduce RTO in dropshipping. Now let's see how much money we can make. Step 3, ads. For every product, I stole our competitors' ads and ran them on Facebook at 500 rupees per day per product. Let's see the results. The tally counter got 3 sales and made us 2,500 rupees. The 360 degree mop got 8 sales and made us 10,000 rupees. The magnetic phone mount got 3 sales and made us 4,500 rupees. Total, we made 17,000 rupees with an ad spend of 8,000 rupees. Proof is in this video. Comment proof if you want it with Emergent link.
caption: Comment “PROOF” to get the Link in your Dms
